source_snapshot.procedure: Enable persistence, run level 4, then start service.

old_problem: Although both source and DeepSeek chose level 4, the service was started after invocation and the case lacked pattern/coverage identity, exclusive memory ownership and persistent health deltas.
disposition_reason: NVIDIA documents `memtest` as level-4-only with configurable patterns and duration. Correct service readiness, a pinned pattern manifest and zero live target contexts resolve the review without altering coverage.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row367 all 18 XLSX columns and history2962.
Applied official level-4 Memtest pattern semantics.
No GPU allocation, memory write, service or diagnostic action occurred.

test_case.test_name: DCGM level-4 Memtest pattern and persistent-health validation
test_case.purpose: Execute every approved Memtest pattern on exclusively drained selected GPUs and prove data integrity with no ECC/XID/retirement/remap or availability regression.
required_package: Pinned DCGM/driver/GPU matrix and reviewed memtest script/hash/config
Enabled pattern list, per-pattern duration and coverage rules
Isolation, thermal/power monitoring, OOB and device recovery
test_case.test_command: Preserve logs and capture per-GPU memory use/health; establish supported DCGM service and approved persistence state, confirm exclusive target ownership, run the pinned source-level-4 Memtest once, retain every pattern/result, recapture health and restore runtime state.
test_case.expected_result: Every enabled pattern completes PASS for every selected UUID, no expected pattern is skipped, and no prohibited integrity, ECC, XID, retirement, remap, thermal, power or device-availability delta occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exclusive memory ownership, complete pinned pattern accounting and stable persistent health; suite exit 0 alone or overwritten live allocations cannot pass.
safety_gate: Explicit owner approval and proof of zero live target contexts
Abort on first integrity or health anomaly and never auto-retry
expected_evidence: Final enumeration, service/persistence and thermal/power health
test_case.recovery: Abort on fault, quarantine the affected GPU, restore only recorded service/persistence state, verify enumeration and host health, preserve all evidence and do not rerun automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Documented level-4 Memtest semantics and pre-run service readiness resolve the execution-order conflict while retaining the exact level.

blocked.reason: The test semantics are documented; patterns/entities and safety values are runtime inputs.
